name: Field Smoothing Pass — Density Field Smoothing, Field Blur
definition: A preprocessing step that applies a smoothing filter to the electromagnetic-potential scalar field on the GPU before isosurface extraction to suppress high-frequency variations and produce spatially coherent surfaces.
summary: Field Smoothing Pass is a GPU-based preprocessing step that filters the scalar field before extraction to suppress high-frequency noise and produce spatially coherent surfaces, unlike mesh-based methods that alter extracted geometry.
